breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed instruction to use the bending second moment of area (I) for torsion calculations. Instead, it correctly specified using the polar second moment of area (J = π d^4/32) for both the shear stress and angle of twist calculations, which matches the correction made in the ground truth.
